title: AgentsStepAppendedPayload
description: agents.step.appended v1 (one agent system, 2026-11-12). A step was appended to a run: the payload is the appended agents.step@1, whole. OpenVibe.Events carries it with the run's owner as the subject, the product that ran it as the source (actor, codes, run, …) and visibility subject; a reader follows a run live without polling the step log. The namespace is agents (hyphen-free: Events namespaces cannot contain a hyphen). One producer per run: the product that stores the run publishes its steps, and the step's own product names the agent.
